articles.title: El Niño weather system set to be 'strongest in living memory', warns Met Office
articles.description: Scientists say the growing El Niño weather pattern is an "unprecedented event" and means 2027 is likely to be the world's hottest year on record.

articles.title: Israeli settlers return to Kadim in West Bank two decades after it was evacuated
articles.description: Thirty "pioneer families" have arrived on a wave of nationalism driven by Israel's government, but the rapid change has left nearby Palestinian residents fearful.
